title: project.save
description: Saves the project to its project file, as Save in OpenTune's file menu does, as a job of kind projectSave (PROTOCOL.md section 12). A project that was never saved has no file, and the call fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT(no_project_path); project.saveAs saves it. The job writes the project through a temporary file in the same directory and the final rename of section 20.4, and writes the project's media next to it as OpenTune does; it cannot be cancelled. Its result (jobResult) is the write envelope with the file that was written (path, sizeBytes). The unsaved-changes flag is cleared, unless the project changed while the job ran. The file's previous content is replaced, and no request of this protocol restores it: the undo reason is no_upstream_undo, revert is null, and the result carries the warning IRREVERSIBLE. Some state is not part of the project file: the result carries the warning NOT_SAVED_IN_PROJECT with data {items}, the names undoHistory and preferences. A write that fails ends the job with IO_ERROR(write_failed) and leaves the file as it was.

path.description: The project file that was written.
